Tip: in Our Love Story and Our Moments you’ll find + Add buttons, and ✕ / arrows on each chapter and photo to remove or reorder them.
Add Text
Add a line of your own wording anywhere — a tagline, a heading, a short note, a paragraph. Pick where it goes, then type directly on the page. You can also click any text and use “Add a new text line below this one” under Selected Text. Style it afterwards under Selected Text (font, size, colour, animation).

Wishes & WhatsApp
What happens when a guest taps “Send via WhatsApp”.
Off by default — the message is just the guest’s name and wishes. Guests save their own thank-you card from the page after sending.
Thank-You Card
Guests see this card the moment they send their wishes and can save or share it in one tap. (A web page can’t push an automatic WhatsApp message to a guest’s phone — this is the closest thing that works anywhere.)

Save Your Changes
Nothing saves automatically. Export a new file whenever you want to lock changes in, then deploy it to Vercel (keep vercel.json next to it). The exported file stays fully editable at /ALWEDINVEDIT.
